name: Drush dialog
description: Provides a drush dialog for the site administrator.
project_description: Drush dialog adds an in-page overlay, opened with the Ctrl+D keyboard shortcut, that lets a user holding the core 'administer site configuration' permission type a Drush command and run it directly from the browser. The typed string is sent by AJAX to a controller (DrushDialogController::run) that invokes the drush binary via Symfony Process, returns the command output as a JSON string, and stores each command plus its output in a per-user database log table (drush_dialog_log). The stored commands feed an up/down-arrow history in the dialog. The module ships no settings form, no permissions of its own, and no Drush commands of its own; it depends only on Drupal core and on a working Drush install on the server.
